ruling: Ruling (Krish, 2026-10-29): At U3 to U5, engines and Control Center may raise volume caps up to each repo's existing policy bounds without a signed week spec. This is volume only: walls unchanged.

daily_posts.why: A channel's posting cap rises only to its own policy bound in engine/social.py: Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and X four a day with a floor of three (Ruling, Krish, 2026-10-29), Substack Notes two (27 Oct), every other channel one. Every channel already sits at its bound, so no urgency caps those four below three. A human-only channel (LinkedIn, null) gets no automatic posts at any urgency.

engagement_taps.why: Five was the radar's daily ceiling. Control Center's copy_open task carries at most 25 taps (protocol 1.14.0); these stay under it. Every tap still clears the bar in docs/ENGAGEMENT-LOOP.md.

unchanged: Walls, spend (zero), Krish's 20 and 30 minute daily budget, the creative bar and every approval stay as they are at every urgency.
